channel.title: Corea Labs | South Korea Cultural Heritage, Seasonal Festivals & Travel Guide (11 Languages)
channel.description: Official multilingual guide to South Korea's 27 seasonal festivals, 5 Joseon royal palaces, UNESCO heritage sites, public transit routes from Seoul, and essential foreign traveler tips in 11 languages.

item.title: 27 Must-Visit Seasonal Festivals in South Korea (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter) with KTX & Bus Transit Guides
item.description: Explore 27 iconic South Korean seasonal festivals including Jinhae Gunhangje Cherry Blossom Festival, Boryeong Mud Festival, Jinju Namgang Lantern Festival, Andong Mask Dance Festival, and Hwacheon Sancheoneo Ice Festival with step-by-step KTX and express bus transit instructions from Seoul.

item.title: Essential South Korea Travel Guide for Foreigners: K-ETA, WOWPASS, T-Money, Naver Map & 1330 Helpline
item.description: Complete arrival and survival handbook for international visitors to South Korea: Incheon Airport AREX train, K-ETA and Q-Code rules, WOWPASS all-in-one prepaid & T-Money transit card, eSIM setup, tax refunds, and 1330 24/7 tourist interpretation helpline.

item.title: Seoul's 5 Grand Joseon Royal Palaces & UNESCO World Heritage Guide (Free Hanbok Admission)
item.description: Discover Gyeongbokgung, Changdeokgung Secret Garden, Deoksugung, Changgyeonggung, Gyeonghuigung, Jongmyo Shrine, and Seokguram Grotto. Includes Royal Guard Changing Ceremony schedules, closed days, and free Hanbok entry tips.

item.title: Best Places & Regional Cities to Visit in South Korea: Seoul, Busan, Jeju, Gyeongju, Gangneung & Jeonju
item.description: Curated city itineraries and hidden gems across South Korea: Bukchon Hanok Village, Gamcheon Culture Village in Busan, Seongsan Ilchulbong in Jeju, Gyeongju historic district, Jeonju Hanok Village, and Gangneung coastal trails.

item.title: Traditional Korean Culture Guide: Hanbok, Hansik Cuisine, Hanok Architecture, Pansori & Temple Stay
item.description: Deep dive into living Korean traditions: wearing Hanbok at royal palaces, authentic Hansik dining etiquette, traditional Ondol & Hanok architecture, UNESCO intangible heritage Pansori, and Korean Temple Stay experiences.

item.title: Global Korea Travel Q&A Community Board & 24/7 Multilingual Travel Concierge
item.description: Ask questions and get instant answers on South Korea itineraries, KTX tickets, cherry blossom dates, Halal/vegetarian dining, and luggage storage in 11 languages.
